name: Viridescent-Quoin
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
For traders, antimatter traces alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
